# Model Compatibility

DNALLM depends on a widely used AI library called *transformers*, which is the software that loads and runs the models. That library has released a new major version (version 5), and the team tested every preset model that ships with DNALLM against it.

Of the 49 preset models, the team found 19 working as-is, 21 with their program code loading verified (the full run is expected to match a tested close relative in the same model family), 1 working through DNALLM's built-in compatibility fixes, 6 not working with the new version, and 2 that could not be checked.
